title: Hash Database Lookup Configuration
description: getConfiguration() returns a Pair<Boolean excludeKnown, String nsrlConfig>. Jackson serializes Apache Commons Pair via its Map.Entry semantics as a single entry keyed by the *string value* of excludeKnown (e.g. {"true": "..."}), so no fixed property name can be validated here. Schema intentionally only checks the outer shape until this config is migrated to a named POJO.
